newsitem.title: THAILAND: PTTEP reports development area gas find.
newsitem.headline: PTTEP reports development area gas find.

text.p: Thai oil company PTT Exploration and Production Plc said on Thursday drilling of the Jenda-1 field in the B17 block in the Thai-Malaysian joint development area had yielded gas and oil.

The firm said in a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand its unit PTT Exploration and Production International, and its Malaysian partner Carigalli had found natural gas with a overall flowing rate of 48 million cubic feet per day, condensed at 1,451 barrels per day.
The drillings by Thai-Malaysain joint venture Carigalli-PTTEPI Operating Sendiran Berhad (CPOC) to depths of 1,892-2,182 metres had also yielded crude oil at 585 barrels per day.
Thailand and Malaysia are cooperating to explore and develop the 7,250 square kilometres Joint Development Area in Thai and Malaysian water.
